attributes.action: Make it illegal to damage and cut down ancient woodland
attributes.additional_details: These areas are protected, but somehow certain councils are allowing them to be cut down for development.
attributes.background: To make it illegal to cause the destruction of ancient woodland and other protected SSSI’s

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for the same action:

Ban the removal or felling of ancient trees 
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775748
